messages:
olivia (docs): FYI I opened a PR to unify tool-calling examples and introduce an `envelope` response pattern for structured outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513

andre (eng-runtime): Nice. Quick: do we use `status: ok/error` or HTTP-like codes? SDK helpers expect lowercase `ok/error`.

olivia (docs): Leaning `ok/error`. Proposed envelope: {
  "status": "ok|error",
  "result": <object|null>,
  "error": <{code: string, message: string}|null>
}

tara (devex): Please include both Node and Python parse+validate examples and remove any `eval()` usage. I'll add a lint note to flag eval in docs.

olivia (docs): Done. Python snippet:```python
resp = client.call_tool('parse_invoice', invoice_text, schema=invoice_schema)
if resp['status'] != 'ok':
    raise Exception(resp['error']['message'])
invoice = schema_validate(resp['result'], invoice_schema)
```

zack (eng-ml): Add a short section on streaming: reassemble chunks then validate. Also warn about partial JSON when models truncate; suggest retries with higher max_tokens or a parse helper tool.

andre (eng-runtime): Also recommend final integrity check after streaming join. I'll add a runtime note to the SDK smoke tests to ensure chunk reassembly preserves ordering.

tara (devex): I found one old link to parser-guide-v1. Left a comment on the PR to update it. Can the link-bot run a sweep pre-merge?

link-bot: Link check queued. Will post results on the PR.

olivia (docs): I replaced evals, added jq debugging tips, included backoff strategies: partial-JSON backoff -> retry with higher max_tokens -> fallback to parse_tool. Also documented schema field-level error handling.

andre (eng-runtime): I'll run a quick SDK test after the link fixes. If green, approve.

tara (devex): Small ask: add a short example that shows how to handle `result: null` gracefully (e.g., non-blocking telemetry + retry).

olivia (docs): Added that snippet. Checklist in PR description: remove eval(), add streaming integrity note, include parse-fallback, update links. Aiming to merge today if all reviews pass. :rocket:
